# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148. It adds variable fonts, animated WebP encoding, a Graphite-ready singleton lifecycle rework, and new GPU/interop APIs. This is a breaking release for some Vulkan and font-default consumers — check the changes below before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **new SKFont() now has an empty typeface, not a lazy default** — Upstream removed the lazy resolve-default-at-draw-time pattern, so an SKFont built without an explicit typeface now stores SKTypeface.Empty and measures/draws nothing. Construct with new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default) to keep the old behavior, and check font.Typeface.IsEmpty instead of comparing to null. ([#3735](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3735))
- **new SKPaint().Typeface now returns Default instead of null** — SKPaint still draws text out of the box, but code that checked paint.Typeface == null to detect 'no typeface set' no longer fires. Use paint.Typeface.IsEmpty instead, or drop the check. ([#3736](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3736))
- **SKTypeface.FromFamilyName("missing") no longer returns null on Android** — All platforms are now consistent: an unknown family returns SKTypeface.Default rather than null. For a strict 'was it found' check, use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name, style), which still returns null on no match. ([#3737](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3737))
- **SKTypeface.Default now resolves through the font manager** — SKTypeface.Default is now guaranteed non-null on every platform, including Android API 36+ where it previously could return null. No migration needed for existing callers. ([#3738](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3738))
- **SKStream.Move(long) now throws on out-of-range offsets and is obsolete** — The overload used to silently truncate offsets beyond int range; it now throws OverflowException and is marked [Obsolete] (CS0618). Call Move(int) with a validated in-range offset instead. ([#3740](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3740))
- **GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on a Vulkan 1.0 context** — Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1; a 1.0 instance/device causes a fatal, uncatchable process abort instead of CreateVulkan returning null. Declare VK_API_VERSION_1_1 both when creating the VkInstance and on GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion (do not leave it at its default 0). 1.0-only hardware can no longer run Ganesh Vulkan and must fall back to raster or another backend up front. ([#4600](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4600))
- **GRVkBackendContextNative dropped five interop fields** — fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice were removed from this interop struct. Use fVkExtensions instead of fExtensions and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 instead of fFeatures; there is no replacement for fOwnsInstanceAndDevice since Skia no longer manages that ownership. ([#3741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3741))
- **GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retyped, and GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo lost value-equality** — GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo is now GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo (adds a new Components field), and the old GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo no longer implements IEquatable or the equality operators. Update field types and replace equality-operator comparisons with manual field comparisons if needed. ([#3741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3741))

## Engine

- **Skia updated through milestones m132 to m148** — Bumps the bundled Skia engine from milestone 132 all the way to 148 across the 4.147.x previews, plus several chrome/m147 bug-fix syncs. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044))

## API Surface

- **Variable font and color font support** — Adds variable font support to SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, color font palette support, and an HBColor struct for hb_color_t; also fixes default-typeface resolution to run in the managed layer. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742), [#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **New stream, WebP and drawing APIs** — Adds SKStream.GetData() for zero-copy stream-to-data conversion, animated WebP encoding via SKWebpEncoder, SKSamplingOptions support on SKSurface.Draw/SKCanvas.DrawSurface, and additional API wrappers with naming-convention fixes. ([#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772), [#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771), [#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **Cleaned up the v4 obsolete surface** — Promotes remaining pre-v4 obsolete legacy paint text/font members and pre-v4 obsolete APIs to compile errors, trimming the obsolete enums from the reference assembly. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114), [#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))

## Bug Fixes

- **Fixed pixel access and finalizer crashes** — SKPixmap/SKBitmap GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes for stride and the correct axis for the generic-offset overload, and a finalizer crash in SKPath is fixed when its SKPathBuilder is collected first. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148), [#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128), [#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **Fixed WinUI and Apple platform issues** — Fixes the WinUI Projection DLL not being found for .NET 9 consumers, and corrects Apple platform TFMs to use 26.0 for libraries and unversioned TFMs for apps. ([#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084), [#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Reworked the singleton lifecycle** — Reworks how singleton native instances are created and torn down, and moves the native-compatibility gate from a module initializer to the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080), [#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Platform

- **Expanded native platform coverage** — Adds Linux Bionic native assets, x64/arm64 native builds for Tizen, and PolySharp support for C# 13 features on legacy TFMs; drops native builds for pre-.NET 8 Emscripten (WASM) versions. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620), [#3642](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3642), [#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))
- **Fixed an Android rendering regression** — Fixes SKGLView not rendering again after switching tabs in a MAUI TabBar. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))

## Security

- **Refreshed bundled native dependencies** — Updates HarfBuzz to 14.2.0, expat to 2.8.1, libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, freetype to 2.14.3, zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley, libpng to 1.6.58, and libexpat to 2.7.5. ([#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035), [#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

Adds variable-font shaping support and an HBColor value type, and refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.0.

## Release Candidate 1 (June 12, 2026)

Reworked the singleton lifecycle and native-compatibility gate, fixed the SKPixmap/SKBitmap pixel-span bugs, promoted remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs to errors, and finished the Skia m148 bump ahead of the stable 4.148.0 release.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.3.1...v4.148.0-rc.1.2)

## Preview 3 (May 24, 2026)

Continued the v4 engine sync with chrome/m147 bug fixes, dropped native builds for pre-.NET 8 WASM, and refreshed several bundled native dependencies for security.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.2.1...v4.147.0-preview.3.1)

## Preview 2 (May 6, 2026)

Added animated WebP encoding, fixed the SKPath finalizer crash, and corrected Apple platform TFMs for libraries and apps.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.1.1...v4.147.0-preview.2.1)

## Preview 1 (April 28, 2026)

Opened the v4 line with the Skia milestone 132/147 bump, variable font and color font support, new WebP encoding and stream APIs, and expanded Bionic and Tizen native platform coverage.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v3.119.4...v4.147.0-preview.1.1)
